_comment: TANUH MViT2 oral-cancer fold ensemble (model6/model8/model8-2 → mvit2_fold1_6/fold1_8/fold2_8) on ONNX Runtime Mobile (engine=onnx). Preprocessing aligned to the QC team's enhanced reference OCS_blackbox.ipynb (Oct 2026; benchmarking_model_scores_127Images.xlsx): EXIF orientation applied before preprocessing (native, EdgeModelModule); LETTERBOX — aspect-preserving cv2.INTER_CUBIC resize so the longer side is 256 (PixelOps.resizeCubicCv, bit-exact port, no OpenCV dependency), centred on a black 256x256 canvas; gray-world mean→128 computed over the whole canvas (padding included); clip; np.round(x,1); uint8 via convertScaleAbs; ÷255 only, no mean/std; BGR to the model. rounding=numpy reproduces numpy/cv2 float32 + round-half-to-even arithmetic. Image verdict = unanimous AND across the 3 folds (combine=unanimous-and); per-model sigmoid-binary, Positive when probability >= 0.5 (threshold_inclusive, as the notebook). Case-level OR is the form/rule layer (ops#231). Parity tooling: tools/edge-model/qc-parity/.
